title: Revenue Integrity
summary: An invoice review workflow that compares bills with cited agreement terms and records approved corrections.
outcome: Give a billing reviewer the source evidence and approval history behind a proposed correction.
sourceNote: Source reviewed from the project worktree.
lead: Review the difference between an invoice and its agreement, approve the exact correction, and verify the resulting receipt.
challenge: A billed amount can differ from the agreement governing it. A correction needs the cited terms, the current invoice version, and a clear record of who approved it.

flow.detail: The local walkthrough parses registered fictional agreements deterministically. The hosted demo can run a bounded model assessment on those registered inputs.
The service validates the quoted terms and compares amounts against PostgreSQL-backed invoice facts with exact arithmetic.
A separate reviewer approves the proposed correction tied to the source, invoice version, and action.
The operator applies the correction. The ledger records a receipt and returns the same receipt for duplicate delivery.

decisions.decision: Keep model evidence validation and reconciliation separate from approval.
decisions.tradeoff: An agreement assessment can supply a citation. Failed or uncertain assessments still require review.

decisions.decision: Bind the correction to the invoice version and use a durable receipt.
decisions.tradeoff: A changed invoice needs a new review. Delivery can be retried without booking the same correction twice.

limits: The walkthrough uses fictional invoices. Performance on unseen customer agreements, missed discrepancies, and false alarms remains unqualified.
diagramAlt: Agreement evidence and invoice facts feed reconciliation. Separate review gates a transactional correction and ledger receipt.
